s.note: the Forbidden City where Chon starts out
s.how: Mix 300g pork mince, 150g chopped prawns, grated ginger and spring onion. Fill 30 dumpling wrappers, pleat and steam 8 minutes. Serve with soy and black vinegar.

s.note: the cowboy side of the partnership
s.how: Heat a buttered cast iron pan in a 220C oven. Mix 150g cornmeal, 100g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, 250ml buttermilk, 1 egg and 60g melted butter briefly. Pour in and bake 20 minutes. Serve with 60g butter beaten with honey.

m.how: Rub 1.5kg pork ribs with 2 tsp five spice, 2 tbsp brown sugar, 3 garlic cloves and salt. Wrap and bake at 150C for 2.5 hours. Unwrap, brush with 4 tbsp hoisin mixed with 2 tbsp honey and glaze under the grill.

w.note: a dessert from both sides of the world
w.how: Bake 16 almond cookies from 125g butter, 120g sugar, 120g almond meal and 120g flour at 170C for 14 minutes. Bake an apple pie of 800g apples with cinnamon in 4 sheets sweet shortcrust at 190C for 50 minutes. Serve together.

d.note: the bathtub drinking game at the saloon
d.how: Pour 45ml rye whisky neat into small glasses. Brew a pot of jasmine tea for anyone sitting it out, and pour both at the same time.
